* Decodes a single EapSimAkaAttribute object from the given ByteBuffer. * *

Decoding logic is based on Attribute definitions in RFC 4186#10. * * @param byteBuffer The ByteBuffer to parse the current attribute from * @return The current EapSimAkaAttribute to be parsed, or EapSimAkaUnsupportedAttribute if the * given attributeType is skippable and unsupported * @throws EapSimAkaInvalidAttributeException when a malformatted attribute is attempted to be * decoded * @throws EapSimAkaUnsupportedAttributeException when an unsupported, unskippable Attribute is * attempted to be decoded
